css: .dish-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; grid-column-gap: 64px; grid-row-gap: 8px; } .dish-item { text-decoration: none; display: flex; align-items: center; grid-column-gap: 22px; padding-top: 22px; padding-bottom: 22px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(20, 22, 19, 0.14); color: #141613; } .dish-thumb { width: 88px; height: 88px; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; flex: none; } .dish-body { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; grid-row-gap: 4px; } .dish-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; grid-column-gap: 14px; } .dish-name { font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.15; color: #141613; transition: color 300ms ease; } .dish-dots { flex: 1; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(20, 22, 19, 0.3); height: 1px; transform: translateY(-5px); } .dish-price { font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.15; color: #141613; } .dish-desc { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; color: #6a6c65; margin: 0; } .tag-row { display: flex; grid-column-gap: 6px; } .tag { font-size: 11px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background-color: rgba(111, 125, 78, 0.16); color: #56613a; } .tag.is-chef { background-color: #141613; color: #f2ede4; } @media screen and (max-width: 991px) { .dish-list { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } } @media screen and (max-width: 479px) { .dish-thumb { width: 64px; height: 64px; } .dish-name { font-size: 22px; } .dish-price { font-size: 22px; } .dish-dots { display: none; } }
